CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reply_to_ticket(p_ticket_id text, p_text text, p_time text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update support_tickets
  set
    messages = messages || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('sender', 'user', 'text', p_text, 'time', p_time)),
    status = 'pending',
    updated_at = now()
  where id = p_ticket_id
    and user_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'sub');

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Ticket not found or not owned by caller';
  end if;
end;
$function$

functions.name: reply_to_ticket_as_support(text,text,text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reply_to_ticket_as_support(p_ticket_id text, p_text text, p_time text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update support_tickets
  set
    messages = messages || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('sender', 'support', 'text', p_text, 'time', p_time)),
    status = 'resolved',
    updated_at = now()
  where id = p_ticket_id
    and (is_admin() or user_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'sub'));

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Ticket not found or not permitted';
  end if;
end;
$function$
